cadence.label: Seven-day floor still running
cadence.explanation: A routine release must wait until this time. Only a documented exceptional release may publish sooner.

interpretation.membership: Every visible, ratified language entry absent from the latest bundle appears here. Being chosen as a flagship example is not required for inclusion.
interpretation.control_room: Required bundle fields are checked automatically: form, lossless English mapping, ratification version and ratification date. Evidence summaries and optional flagship explanations provide context; they do not add release gates.
interpretation.preview_boundary: This is a changing comparison with the last frozen bundle. It is not a staged candidate, a release decision or an instruction to build one.
